## Experience

**Program Associate** — International Forum for Environment, Sustainability &
Technology (iFOREST), Delhi · Jul 2025 –

Compiled and ran WRF from scratch on cloud HPC for two Indian cities, reaching
3.25 K RMSE on 2 m air temperature. Built the Digital Urban Climate Twin chain
(WRF → PALM-4U → CEA) for testing heat-island interventions, with PALM-4U static
driver generation automated. Automated WUDAPT training-area generation from urban
morphometry, giving LCZ maps at 75–80% accuracy, and benchmarked XGBoost against
a CNN on identical inputs to attribute per-class performance.

**Research Assistant** — Royal Danish Academy, Copenhagen · Aug 2021 – Dec 2022

Developed and remotely monitored four low-cost IoT particulate sensors that
outperformed commercial units, including a six-month deployment in Tanzania.
Built RANS CFD models in OpenFOAM and ANSYS Fluent for architectural wind flow,
validated against measured PET and UTCI in experimental solar homes.

**Project Manager** — Fairfest Media, Mumbai · Jun 2018 – Jul 2019

Led a multi-city team producing urban-sector insight for partners; market
segmentation and financial modelling for trade-show positioning.
